carryForward.title: Year-end carry forward
carryForward.help: On the first day of the new leave year, unused days of carry-forward types carry over up to the cap and the rest lapse; other types lapse and comp-off is untouched. Negative balances carry over as a deduction. This preview is exactly what year end will write; after it runs it shows what was written.

employees.title: Employees
employees.csvHelp: Columns: email, full_name, employee_code, department, date_of_joining (YYYY-MM-DD), role (employee, approver or admin), approver_group (created if missing).

employee.dojHelp: Changing the joining date does not change allotments already made; adjust the balance if needed.
employee.anonymiseHelp: Their name and email are replaced everywhere, including the audit log; leave reasons, comments and documents are deleted. Dates, days and balance entries stay so totals remain correct. This cannot be undone.

approvers.title: Approver groups
approvers.help: A group's approvers decide the requests of the employees assigned to it. Admins can decide any request. Employees without a group go to every approver.
approvers.noCandidates: Make someone an approver on their employee page first.
approvers.deleteHelp: Its {{count}} employees will have no group; their requests go to every approver.

import.title: Import
import.help: Bring employees, opening balances and this year's leave from Keka or another HR tool. Preview first: nothing changes until you import, and the import runs only when there are no errors. Imported balances replace earlier imported balances; imported leave shows as approved and is not deducted again.

formats.keka: Keka's leave balance report (Email, Employee Name, Leave Type, Available Balance; Employee Number and Date Of Joining if present) and, optionally, the leave report (Email, Leave Type, From Date, To Date, No Of Days, Status). Only approved leave is imported.
formats.csv: Balances: email, full_name (for new people), leave_type_code, leave_year, available_days; optional date_of_joining, employee_code, department, approver_group. History: email, leave_type_code, from_date, to_date, days; optional reason, approved_by_email.

import.mappingHelp: Choose the Leavo leave type for each Keka leave type, then preview again.
import.skipped: {{count}} leave rows not approved in Keka are left out.
